name: slash_tear
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A standalone 2D game VFX sprite for a Persona 5 Joker mod: bold hand-painted anime/comic shapes, clean controlled ink accents, high contrast, no 3D or photorealism. GENUINE TRANSPARENT RGBA PNG: alpha zero outside the actual sprite; never paint a dark backdrop, colored haze, vignette, checkerboard or ground. Soft glow must taper to transparent at the outer edge. Keep the whole sprite inside the canvas with transparent margin, no clipping. No text, watermark, characters or additional objects. One horizontal jagged space tear, opaque pure black inside the fissure, sawtooth glowing red and white edges. Hand-drawn white luminous core and crimson red edge, optional tiny black dry-brush accents; transparent surroundings, no weapon, no wielder. Canvas 2048x1024 pixels.
processing: 保留raw；交付尺寸归一化，alpha<=2残点及全透明RGB清零；未抠底。
